meta.notes: Controls, repeatability, a grudge against bad reception. Near the bulkhead before the boundary; the two tapes. His voice at 21:00:40 clears him of nothing and he is simply not where the evidence meets. Does not summarise. Tunes around the noun.

threads.topic: What do you actually listen for?
threads.source: World. Bank line kept to a ritual; no speech system is promised.

threads.topic: You were at the bulkhead that night.
threads.source: B10, 4.1. His private marks and their limit.
S13, 4.6, B19. Shows the door and lets the player compare.

cd_b1.line: Have you a good joke? No? Even better. The receiver prefers the bad ones; they travel farther. I'm serious. Clean signal dies at the river. A really poor pun you can pick up in Yonkers.

choices.label: Do you ever pick up the ones overhead?

cd_b2.line: Everyone's had a go. Not a peep on any band I own. They aren't talking to you. I find that restful. It's more than I can say for WLBQ.

cd_r1.line: I was at the door with the long wire. Tapes start on the eight o'clock pips, you can set a watch by them, unlike some. I've got her at the parapet, I've got me saying "There," twenty seconds to nine-oh-one. Then Mrs. Bell with a hammer. Then the hum drops out at nine-oh-one and I'm on a stair in the dark with a very expensive tape of nothing.

choices.label: Did you see anyone else up there?

cd_r2.line: No. Something at the tank. I took it for the tank. You hear tanks tick, when they cool. That's what I'd say if you asked me on a good day. Don't ask me on a good day.

cd_p1.line: Sit. Don't talk. "Inspector, the clock is four minutes fast." Wait. There. Door. Every time.

choices.label: That's the line Jonah wrote down.

cd_p2.line: On the nineteenth? That went out on the twelfth. Play it again. Door.

cd_p3.line: Static from four minutes to nine. You want to hear static, I've got an hour of it. WLBQ had a different episode listed anyway, I've got the card, and nobody else carried it. So I don't know what your friend heard on the sixth floor. I know what wasn't on the air.
